instructions:
You are fixing a bug in the Go repository checked out at /echo (this is the labstack/echo v4 web framework). Do not use the internet. Do not look at any other copy/version of echo on the machine; work only from /echo.

BUG: In /echo/middleware/proxy.go the proxy balancers panic when they have no targets. `randomBalancer.Next` does `b.targets[b.random.Intn(len(b.targets))]` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` does `b.targets[b.i]` after `b.i = b.i % uint32(len(b.targets))` — with an empty target list `len(b.targets)==0` causes an integer divide-by-zero / index-out-of-range panic. The proxy middleware `ProxyWithConfig` also dereferences the returned target (`c.Set(config.ContextKey, tgt)`, `proxyRaw(tgt, c)`, `proxyHTTP(tgt, c, config)`) without checking for nil, so a proxy configured with a balancer that has no targets panics the server instead of responding.

REQUIRED FIX (do exactly this, minimal, no unrelated changes, no reformatting of other code):
1. In `func (b *randomBalancer) Next(c echo.Context) *ProxyTarget`: keep the existing `b.random == nil` initialization, then take `b.mutex.RLock()` / `defer b.mutex.RUnlock()`, then `if len(b.targets) == 0 { return nil }` before indexing.
2. In `func (b *roundRobinBalancer) Next(c echo.Context) *ProxyTarget`: add `if len(b.targets) == 0 { return nil }` at the top (before the modulo), keeping the rest of the round-robin behaviour unchanged.
3. In `ProxyWithConfig`, inside the returned handler, right after `tgt := config.Balancer.Next(c)` add:
   ```go
   if tgt == nil {
       return echo.ErrServiceUnavailable
   }
   ```
   (so a proxy with no available upstream returns HTTP 503 instead of panicking).

VERIFICATION (all commands must be run with bash, working dir /echo):
- FIRST record the baseline: run `cd /echo && go build ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -40` and save the output to /tmp/baseline.txt so you know which tests were already failing before any edit.
- Apply the fix.
- Create a TEMPORARY test file /echo/middleware/zz_tmp_notargets_check_test.go (package middleware) that checks: (a) `NewRandomBalancer(nil).Next(c)` returns nil without panicking, (b) `NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{}).Next(c)` returns nil without panicking, (c) an echo instance using `Proxy(NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{}))` serving a GET / request returns HTTP status 503 with no panic, (d) same with `Proxy(NewRandomBalancer(nil))`. Run `cd /echo && go test ./middleware/ -run 'TestTmpNoTargets' -v` and confirm it passes. THEN DELETE that temporary test file (it must not remain in the repo) and confirm with `ls /echo/middleware/zz_tmp_notargets_check_test.go` that it is gone.
- Then run the full suite again: `cd /echo && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -40` and compare with /tmp/baseline.txt: no test that passed in the baseline may now fail.
- Also run `cd /echo && gofmt -l middleware/proxy.go` (must print nothing) and `cd /echo && go vet ./middleware/`.

CONSTRAINTS: Do not modify or delete any pre-existing test file. Do not add new features. Do not edit files other than /echo/middleware/proxy.go (plus the temporary test file you create and then delete). Do not run git commands that change state (no commit, no checkout, no stash).

REPORT BACK: the exact diff of /echo/middleware/proxy.go (git diff output), the baseline failing-test list, the result of the temporary test run, the full-suite result before vs after, and confirmation the temporary test file was deleted. If anything failed, say precisely what.

  - `TestContext_Scheme/ignores_invalid_forwarded_headers_and_falls_back_to_http`

ROOT CAUSE: `func (c *context) Scheme()` (around line 252 of /echo/context.go) returns the raw value of the `X-Forwarded-Proto` header (and later `X-Forwarded-Protocol`, `X-Url-Scheme`) whenever it is non-empty, without checking that the value is actually a valid scheme. So a bogus header value (e.g. `X-Forwarded-Proto: invalid`) is returned as the scheme instead of being ignored, and it should fall through to the next header (`X-Forwarded-Protocol`) and ultimately to `"http"`.

REQUIRED FIX (minimal, in /echo/context.go only):
- Keep the existing order and the existing `c.IsTLS()` -> "https" short-circuit and the `X-Forwarded-Ssl == "on"` -> "https" rule unchanged.
- For each of the three headers `HeaderXForwardedProto`, `HeaderXForwardedProtocol`, `HeaderXUrlScheme`: only use the header value when it is a valid scheme, i.e. when it equals `http` or `https` ignoring case (use `strings.EqualFold`). When valid, return the header value exactly as it was received (do not lowercase it). When the value is non-empty but not a valid scheme, ignore it and continue to the next check.
- Final fallback stays `return "http"`.
- Keep the code simple and readable; do not reformat unrelated code, do not add new exported API, do not add features.
